exposure: Conservative management (cesarean delivery with successful placental separation)
outcome: Surgical outcomes (blood loss, operative time, transfusion, partial bladder resection)
Maternal outcomes (death, length of stay, ICU admission, postoperative hemoglobin level)
Neonatal outcomes (Apgar score, neonatal weight, admission to neonatal intensive care unit, neonatal death)
cohort: 189 patients with abnormally invasive placenta (AIP) managed in three leading centers in Lebanon
finding: Management of AIP in Lebanon has led to excellent outcomes with no maternal mortality occurring in scheduled radical treatment.
mod_finding: Unscheduled radical delivery was associated with lower gestational age, more blood loss, higher rate and volume of transfusion, and increased risk of maternal and neonatal death.
gest_age: 34 4/7 weeks (radical treatment subgroup), 36 weeks (conservative treatment subgroup)
